from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, json
root=Path.cwd()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('training',root/'benchmarks/bench_cuda_training.py')
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
from donkeycar_hy.model import DonkeyNet
model=DonkeyNet(dropout_rate=0.)
state=module.initialize(model,(3,66,200),42)
rows=[{'parameter':name,'shape':list(value.shape),'elements':int(value.size),'bytes':int(value.nbytes),'blocks_256':int((value.size+255)//256)} for name,value in state.items()]
result={'source':'CPU DonkeyNet(dropout_rate=0.) + bench_cuda_training.initialize(shape=(3,66,200), seed=42)','gpu_used':False,'fingerprints_computed':False,'parameters':rows,'tensor_count':len(rows),'total_elements':sum(row['elements'] for row in rows),'total_bytes':sum(row['bytes'] for row in rows),'blocks_256':sum(row['blocks_256'] for row in rows)}
dest=root/'docs/experiments/fused-sgd-cuda/results/parameter-shapes.json'
dest.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
with dest.open('x') as stream:
    json.dump(result,stream,indent=2)
    stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
